tweets.text: An illegal alien with three outstanding warrants for DUI and criminal damage-deface was arrested by Wellton Station agents as part of a vehicle stop along Interstate 8 east of Yuma last week. Carlos Andres Ramirez Perez, a 26-year-old Guatemalan, was charged with alien inadmissibility under 8 USC 1182 and will be turned over to Phoenix-area law enforcement for the warrants before he is removed from the U.S. A detainer will be placed on him to request his return to federal authorities to complete the removal process once his state charges are resolved. The other illegal aliens – one Colombian and two Mexican nationals – were charged with immigration violations and processed for removal. #WelltonStation #YumaSector #BorderSecurityIsNationalSecurity
